sentences.diagnosis: The literal preservation instruction is absent from baseline episode and claim evidence before consolidation, so its initial omission is an extraction/evidence-selection gap. It remains absent after consolidation and from both emitted unions. The underlying source-timestamp requirement and reason exist as open claims in both arms; candidate answers q5/q6 communicate them. Thus the missing exact sentence does not establish loss of the substantive obligation. No independent reader failure on this specific absent sentence is demonstrated.
sentences.lexical_limit: Exact absence alone cannot exclude equivalent paraphrases. The classifications above include agent inspection of claim text and answer prose. They do not regrade answers or prove a rendering implementation defect.
